newsitem.title: USA: Whitman shares up on spin-off plan.
newsitem.headline: Whitman shares up on spin-off plan.

text.p: Shares of Whitman Corp rose 2-5/8 to 26 after the company said it plans to spin off its Hussmann Corp and Midas International businesses in a move that analysts had been anticipating.
"It makes strong strategic sense," said Donaldson, Lufkin and Jenrette analyst Skip Carpenter. "Focusing on the bottling operation is what management indicates that it always wanted to do."
After the planned spin-off, Whitman would focus on its Pepsi-Cola General Bottlers business, which is the world's largest independent Pepsi-Cola franchisee.
Analysts said they see strong fundamentals for Hussmann, the world's largest supplier of refrigeration systems for the food industry.
"Hussmann's doing very well. It has a lot of momentum," Salomon Brothers analyst Jennifer Solomon said.

Analysts added that Midas may continue to face some challenges due to changes in fundamentals for the automotive service franchise. These challenges include competition and a softness in consumer demand for automotive repair services.
